resources.name: Open-source finite-element multiphysics solver (e.g., Elmer FEM)

access.notes: Any open-source solver supporting 3-D piezoelectric brick elements (similar to ANSYS Solid5) is acceptable.

resources.notes: The original study used ANSYS Solid5; an equivalent open-source tool (e.g., Elmer, Code_Aster, custom code) must be used.

resources.name: PZT-7A material properties

access.notes: The full set of elastic, piezoelectric, and dielectric constants for polarized PZT-7A (transversely isotropic, poling along x3) is provided in the instruction.md as a table from the original paper. No external fetch needed.

resources.notes: Material constants are known public data; they are embedded in the task instructions.
